nodes.text: After looking at the WHO's report released in the last 24 hours on the respiratory infections in the Northern Hemisphere incl HMPV..all I can say is that I hope Trump keeps to his word & withdraws America for the WHO & also gets other ally countries to do so. Hopeless agency!
